criteria_results.criterion_text: The test is gated behind the `@integration`/`slow` markers and is **not**
criteria_results.evidence: Created test_shell_steps_integration.py with @pytest.mark.integration and @pytest.mark.slow decorators on both test classes. Verified with 'pytest -m "not slow"' that all 7 tests are deselected. Exit code 5 confirms no tests selected.

criteria_results.criterion_text: When run, the fleet-memory smoke script executes to completion against the
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented test_smoke_script_executes_and_verdict_equals_exit_status which: 1) builds a Step pointing to real smoke.sh at ~/Projects/appmilla_github/fleet-memory/deploy/nas/smoke.sh, 2) resolves handler via register_shell_handlers + registry, 3) executes the step, 4) asserts verdict matches exit status (passed if 0, failed if non-zero). Test skips cleanly when throwaway target not configured.

criteria_results.criterion_text: No credentials from the script output appear in the step result (the scrub
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented test_no_credentials_in_step_result_from_real_script which: 1) reads FLEET_MEMORY_PG_PASSWORD from throwaway .env.deploy, 2) runs smoke.sh through handler, 3) asserts password does NOT appear in captured_output, 4) verifies ***REDACTED marker IS present. Leverages existing scrub_process_output from TASK-SSH-002.

criteria_results.criterion_text: The test skips cleanly (pytest `skip`, not error) when the smoke script
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented _skip_if_resources_unavailable() helper that checks: 1) smoke.sh exists, 2) FLEET_MEMORY_THROWAWAY_ENV is set and points to existing file. Tests call this helper and pytest.skip() with descriptive reason when resources unavailable. Verified with 'pytest -m slow' that 3 tests skip cleanly when env var not set. Added dedicated tests: test_skips_cleanly_when_smoke_script_unavailable and test_skips_cleanly_when_throwaway_target_unavailable.

criteria_results.criterion_text: A guard prevents the test from ever pointing at a production target
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented _is_production_target() guard function that scans .env.deploy for production host patterns (nas.finproxy.co.uk, production, prod, fleet-memory-prod). _skip_if_resources_unavailable() calls this guard and pytest.fail() (not skip) if production target detected. Added test_production_guard_prevents_test_against_production_target that verifies guard detects production patterns and passes throwaway patterns.
